content.text: Submitted. The repaired proposal keeps the locked **deviation** status and the fallback level, with two minimal edits to Section 6.1: the term-length swap (twelve months from the Effective Date) and a tight proviso terminating the Section automatically on HDI's failure to meet any service level or delivery date obligation. The surplus words ("without penalty or Termination Payment", "availability", "including Section 1.6") are removed, and the second operation now anchors enough unchanged same-sentence text to clear the official minimality gate (ok:true, no errors).
